en: Black‑and‑white image showing an ornate parliamentary or council chamber filled with formally dressed men seated in rows of wooden desks. Large crystal chandeliers hang from the ceiling, the walls are richly paneled with pilasters and sculptures, and a framed portrait of a dignitary is visible on the far wall. The scene appears to depict a formal legislative or governmental session in a grand 19th‑century style hall.
